text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, as we're walking through
the
shopping district...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: H-hey, Big Sister?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Here... th-this is for you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I take a piece of paper from Rice
Shower's
trembling hands.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Urara told me about it.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
There's a New Year's raffle in the
shopping
district.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The special prize is supposed to be
something
really incredible! So... um...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got you a ticket. I want you to give it a
try.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got you a ticket. I want you to give it a
try.
choice_data_list: ……じゃあ一緒に挑戦してみようか

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh? No way! If I'm involved, there's no
way we'll
w—
choice_data_list: ……じゃあ一緒に挑戦してみようか

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep!
choice_data_list: そういうことは言わない！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Eep!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand-prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We've got some takers! Step on up and
give it a
shot!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-you really want to do it... together?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Praying for good luck, we grasp the
raffle
spinner's handle together and
turn...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A small plastic ball drops from the
spinner's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! You did it, you did it!
Congrats, Big
Brother!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whooooa! You did it, you did it!
Congrats, Big
Sister!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but you're the one who won, not
me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, but you're the one who won, not
me.
choice_data_list: でもライスも一緒に引いただろ？
でもライスも一緒に引いたでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Well...
choice_data_list: でもライスも一緒に引いただろ？
でもライスも一緒に引いたでしょ？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The grand-prize is just as much hers as it
is mine.
choice_data_list: だからこれは2人で手に入れた特賞！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Is it really okay for me to take it too?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Umm... in that case... d-does...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... we'll go to the hot
spring
together?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Since we both won... I'd like to go with
you.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is that okay?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: R-really?!
choice_data_list: ライスがそう言うなら！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well then, once we've done
everything we
want to do and need a
break, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Well then, once we've done
everything we
want to do and need a
break, let's go!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, Rice Shower and I promise to
use the hot
spring vacation ticket
together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-first-prize?! I can't believe it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: F-first-prize?! I can't believe it!
choice_data_list: ライスと一緒に引いたからかも！

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe... I don't know about that.
choice_data_list: ライスと一緒に引いたからかも！

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text: All right, you two! Here's your prize!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... It looks delicious. My mouth is
already
wateri—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grrrooowl...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Agh! Not now, tummy! Everyone's
watching!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Yes, let's!
choice_data_list: 早く帰ってご飯を食べようか

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It sounds like she's worked up an
appetite to
match the surprise and
happiness she got from
playing the
raffle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We enjoy the delicious deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:

<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wow... there are so many!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Look at all these carrots!

tummy has
room for this many.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Um, let's think... Hmm...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I make some sweets out of them, will
you have
some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If I make some sweets out of them, will
you have
some?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yay! I'm gonna make a ton, then!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
A few days later, I enjoy some
homemade carrot
cookies with Rice
Shower.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the

third-prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: We didn't lose!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I can't believe it. I thought my
bad luck
would bring us absolutely
nothing, like always...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It may be third-prize, but a win is a win.
Rice
Shower keeps the carrot as a
memento of our day
together.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.text:
